entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I'm a bit confused. I have an order and I think I need to send something back. It's a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you happen to have the order number handy?
Umm, let me see. Yes, it's VF8675309. I just... the website was a little overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to make this easy for you. Let me pull up that order. I see the V-Pro SafeTech helmet. What specifically is the issue with it?

Well, the color just isn't what I thought it would be from the picture. It doesn't match my jersey at all, and for safety, I really want everything to be visible and coordinated. I haven't even taken it out of its packaging, the box is unopened.
I understand completely. Wanting the right color for visibility and safety is very important. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see the helmet was delivered 64 days ago.
Oh dear, is that too long? I'm so sorry, I just got overwhelmed and put the box aside.
Not at all! For our standard items like this helmet, VeloFit has a 90-day return policy. You are well within that timeframe. I can definitely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much.

You are very welcome. And since you're one of our VIP customers, I'm going to email you a pre-paid return shipping label right now, so there's no cost to you. Would you like any help finding a helmet in a different color today? I can walk you through some options.
That would be wonderful! Yes, please. You've made this so simple. Thank you, Sarah.
It's my pleasure. The email with the label is on its way. Now, let's take a look at some of our brighter color options...
